theorems.name: Submission.tangentialDivergence_add_inner_eq_sum_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (N p : ℕ) (M S O : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N) (ζ : Fin p → Rn N → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → (∀ q, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ζ q)) → IsClosed S → (∀ x ∉ S, Y x = 0) → IsOpen O → M ∩ S ⊆ O → (∀ z ∈ O, ∑ q, ζ q z = 1) → ∀ y ∈ M, tangentialDivergence M Y y + inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y) = ∑ q, (tangentialDivergence M (fun z ↦ ζ q z • Y z) y + inner ℝ (ζ q y • Y y) (meanCurvature M y))
